title: Deck & Driver
description: Transforms Jukeboxes into Hi-Fi decks and Note Blocks into rotatable speakers. Right-click to rotate!
body:
🎵 Realistic Jukebox & Rotatable Speakers
Upgrade your Minecraft music experience! This resource pack transforms the vanilla sound blocks into detailed, retro-modern audio equipment, perfect for building studios, concert stages, or a cozy living room.

💿 The Jukebox (Turntable & Amp)
Say goodbye to the plain wooden box. The Jukebox has been completely reimagined as a high-fidelity audio system.

Design: It features a detailed cassette deck amplifier base topped with a classic vinyl turntable.

🔊 The Note Block (Speaker)
Note Blocks are now sleek, professional loudspeakers. But it's not just a texture change—we've added a unique feature for builders:

How it Works: Simply Right-Click (Tune) the Note Block to rotate the speaker 90 degrees.
This mechanic allows you to stack speakers, create angled arrays, or build massive sound columns easily. Each right-click rotates the speaker, giving you full control over your setup's orientation.

![Right-click to rotate!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/303e6b0967ed6c617ee49807ac2eef3396409055.gif)

💡 Pro Tip for Realism
To make the Jukebox look even better, place an Item Frame on the top face and insert a Music Disc. This creates the appearance of a real vinyl record sitting on the turntable!

![You can use a picture frame.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a47cc8e8e9504a8f2640912a52e87477b9f7f3e9.gif)

Ready to turn up the volume? Download now and start building your dream sound system!
